summary: Implemented parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError in rdflib/extras/shacl.py, with tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (43 passed) under the prepared venv. Nothing is committed and no other file changed. Caveats: mypy, black, and isort are not installed in the venv, so type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading only. I added a non-Node guard before graph lookups because Graph.value(None, ...) acts as a wildcard. A file edit by someone else (docstring/comment wording) was kept as-is.
